title: Broncos draw even with Chargers after fourth down stop

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Broncos draw even with Chargers after fourth down stop
sources.description: The Chargers had a choice between punting or trying to convert a fourth down in their own territory with just over 10 minutes to play in Sunday's game against the Broncos and head coach Jim Harbaugh opted to go for it.
